# Stack Exchange

Stack Exchange is a network of Q&A communities where users ask questions, share knowledge, and collaborate on topics like coding, math, and more

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/stack-exchange/.

## Actions

- **Get Collective Questions**: Retrieve questions associated with the specified collective.
- **Get Collective Tags**: Retrieve tags associated with specified collectives.
- **Get Collectives**: Retrieve all collectives on a stack exchange site in alphabetical order.
- **Get Comment Flag Options**: Fetch valid flag options for a given comment.
- **Get Comments**: Retrieve comments from a specified stack exchange site.
- **Get Revisions By IDs**: Retrieve revisions for specific posts by their ids.
- **Get Sites**: Retrieve all stack exchange sites and their api site parameter values.
- **Search Questions**: Search the site for questions meeting certain criteria.
